recommendation: Keep this bounded source fix. It completes the published Jira request for active canonical-valued example inputs; any broader cleanup of generated narrative text should be handled separately.
issue_request: FHIR-25737 was a Published/Persuasive CQI change request for R5 asking that PlanDefinition, Library, ActivityDefinition, and Measure examples stop using relative URLs where canonical references require full URI values.
initial_application: The issue was applied by commit 54830d2febad78c584b8fde82d53885061dea26f and merged through HL7/fhir#2879, correcting several clinical reasoning Library references and CMS146 data-requirements examples.
additional_context: Measure and PlanDefinition are active current-build resources in source/fhir.ini. The edited JSON files feed current operation examples through source/measure/$submit-data-request.txt, source/measure/$collect-data-response.txt, and source/plandefinition/$data-requirements-response.txt. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant discussion changing the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Changed MeasureReport.measure in the Measure submit-data and collect-data JSON examples to http://example.org/fhir/Measure/measure-mrp, and changed the PlanDefinition Zika data-requirements relatedArtifact.resource to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/zika-affected-areas.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive CQI issue requesting absolute canonical URLs in PlanDefinition, Library, ActivityDefinition, and Measure examples.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes final WG intent to replace relative canonical references in those examples with full URI values.

evidence_items.summary: Original application commit corrected relative canonical references in clinical reasoning and CMS146 examples.
evidence_items.learned: The issue had an application history, but current-source search still found active JSON operation examples that were missed.

evidence_items.summary: Measure operation examples contained MeasureReport.measure values for Measure/measure-mrp.
evidence_items.learned: MeasureReport.measure is canonical(Measure), so these active examples required absolute Measure canonical URLs.

evidence_items.summary: PlanDefinition data-requirements response used a relative ValueSet/zika-affected-areas relatedArtifact.resource while the ValueSet source defines http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/zika-affected-areas.
evidence_items.learned: The example had a current absolute canonical available and needed to use it.

evidence_items.summary: Measure and PlanDefinition are active resources, and the edited JSON files are included by current operation example text files.
evidence_items.learned: The source changes are in current build scope rather than retired or generated-only artifacts.
